mission: Morning on Veranthos. Final tension — Torin's behavior overnight. He's been meditating near the Scar. His Force presence has changed — lighter, sharper, the heaviness gone. He's already using the technique at personal scale.
why_now: The turn's morning-after. Torin has been preparing overnight. The signs are unmistakable.
conflict: Ben confronts Torin about his overnight meditation near the Scar. Torin is honest — disarmingly, devastatingly honest. He's not hiding. He's not manipulating. He believes this is right.
turning_point: Torin tells Ben about the first time he used the technique — the moment of beauty, clarity without categories. 'It was the truest thing I've ever felt.' His voice is that of a man talking about the love of his life. Ben's horror is not that Torin is lying. It's that he's telling the truth.
opening_hook: Torin is already awake when Ben emerges. He's standing in the same spot as last night. But something is different. He looks... rested. In a place where no one sleeps well.
closing_hook: Torin: 'I'm not asking for permission.' Five words. The temperature of the conversation drops to absolute zero.
emotional_trajectory: Concerned confrontation -> Torin's devastating honesty -> the five words that break everything

stakes.personal: Ben watching history repeat — Jacen's pattern completing in real time
stakes.interpersonal: The group's strongest member declaring independence
stakes.external: Torin's plan (become the new seal) would work — and would repeat every failure that got them here

setting: Veranthos — camp at valley edge, dawn, the Scar visible below
sensory_details: Dawn light on Veranthos — golden but the shadows fall at slightly wrong angles; Torin's Force presence: lighter, sharper, the heaviness that has defined him since awakening — gone; his voice: calm, warm, certain. The certainty is the danger.
action_beats: Ben emerges from the tent at dawn to find Torin standing in the same spot — rested, lighter, his Force presence changed overnight
Ben confronts Torin at the ridgeline and Torin turns without shifting his weight — already grounded, already decided
Torin speaks five words and the temperature between them drops to absolute zero
promises_paid: Torin's certainty is dangerous and he will act on it (PP04)
notes: R11 — 'I'm not asking for permission.' The emotional gut-punch. Torin's arc: point_of_no_return. The turn must be devastating BECAUSE of its warmth, not despite it. He's not a villain. He's a hero making the wrong choice for the right reasons.
